messages.content: Hello, this MPRN 628621802 has an incorrect transfer read on 06/09/2025. We believe it should be 5722. We only have one back read within a year of the CoS date which is (02/09/2025 – 5721). As we only have one back read, we cannot raise a SARs. Would you be able to verbally agree the new CoS read?
